title: HELIX Terminology: Gender Identity
description: Self-reported gender identity. Used by Person resource 'gender_identity' attribute. This is separate from legal/administrative gender.

codes.definition: Indigenous identity. Include only when culturally appropriate.

notes: This terminology is intentionally expansive. Institutions should adopt the subset appropriate to their regulatory and cultural context via Implementation Profiles. The US IPEDS currently requires binary reporting; this terminology supports richer collection while enabling rollup to binary for compliance.
